name: Chi Yin
source:
"Do you still believe in the goodness of this world?"

Du Lin, the protagonist, enters Danbai City for his first assassination mission and crosses paths with a girl named Li Xiye. The unexpected feelings that arise—what kind of complications will they bring to his mission?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140806225909/http://hollowings.com/ci/index.html]the official website[/url]]
